For fiscal year 2026, I expect that total cloud revenue will grow over 40% in constant currency, up from 24% in FY 2025.

source.quote: We continue to anticipate $90 billion-$95 billion in CapEx for the full year, with not more than $70 billion in net cash CapEx.
In Q2, we would expect growth in total revenues of between 30% and 34% in US dollars.
For the full year, reflecting the strong execution and acceleration you see in our Q1, we're upgrading our guidance to at least $90 billion in total revenues.

guide.quote: In Q1, we'd expect growth in total revenues of between 27% and 29% in US dollars.
